Draw the half-drawn ARCHERY mechanics very clearly: anatomical left arm extends toward screen LEFT holding the tall green bow at arm length; right elbow goes screen RIGHT, right hand draws arrow tail back toward chin. The SINGLE BOWSTRING forms one V from top bow tip to ARROW NOCK AT RIGHT FINGERTIPS to bottom bow tip. No string crossing the middle of arrow or green feathers. Arrowhead LEFT, straight shaft lying above left thumb; tail and string terminate together inside right fingers. Right hand halfway between bow grip and right cheek. Distinct grounded feet, slight knee bend. Use exact image1 global body scale and costume.
One independent distinct moment; coherent separated legs and boots; exact anatomical left bow hand and right action hand. No effects, detached projectiles, floor or text.
